args.title: Ignore blank lines in statement parser to prevent malformed row errors
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In `parseStatement`, skip lines that consist entirely of whitespace (or empty lines) after the header and before processing rows, or filter out empty/blank lines when splitting the statement into lines, so that trailing blank lines at the end of files (or blank lines between records) do not cause a 'Malformed row' error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser pops a single trailing newline if present, but files with carriage returns (`\r\n`), multiple blank lines at the end, or whitespace-only lines leave trailing empty lines that are parsed as data rows and fail shape validation. Filtering out blank or whitespace-only lines (or checking if a line is empty before parsing data rows) fixes this.
